source.prompt: Vocal house song, about 3.5 minutes, 124 BPM, Bb major. Uplifting, sunlit and joyful, a warm summer-evening dance floor feeling. Duet: a soulful female lead and a warm male lead trading lines in the verses and singing the chorus together in harmony, with gospel-tinged backing vocals. Rhodes electric piano chords, rolling piano stabs, finger bass, muted funk guitar, lush string section. Four-on-the-floor kick, claps on 2 and 4, offbeat open hats, 16th shaker and tambourine. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge with vocals and piano, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[Intro]
Ooh, yeah

[Verse]
Doors swing open on a summer street
Somebody's radio is playing our beat
You catch my eye from across the floor
I don't need the moon tonight, I want more

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn it up, turn it up, let the feeling rise
Every little light is dancing in your eyes

[Chorus]
Brighter than the bassline, louder than the rain
Every time you hold me, I come alive again
Brighter than the bassline, golden in the haze
You and me together, we can light up the place

[Verse]
Tired of the waiting, tired of the grey
Shake off the Monday, let it fall away
Hands up high where the music lives
Give me all the love that the night can give

[Pre-Chorus]
Turn it up, turn it up, let the feeling rise
Every little light is dancing in your eyes

[Chorus]
Brighter than the bassline, louder than the rain
Every time you hold me, I come alive again
Brighter than the bassline, golden in the haze
You and me together, we can light up the place

[Bridge]
Oh, don't let go, don't let go
Hold this feeling, take it slow
Oh, can you feel it, can you feel it now

[Chorus]
Brighter than the bassline, louder than the rain
Every time you hold me, I come alive again
Brighter than the bassline, golden in the haze
You and me together, we can light up the place
